items.en: May Allah answer he who praises Him.

items.t: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
items.en: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.
items.tl: Rabbanā walaka l-ḥamdu, ḥamdan ka-thyran ṭayyiban mubrakan fīh

items.t: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ العَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
items.en: The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said of You and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.
items.tl: Milʾa as-samawāti wa milʾa l-ʾarḍi, wamā baynahumā, wa milʾa mā shiʾta min shayʾin baʿd. ahla ath-thanʾi wa-l-majdi, aḥaqqu mā qāla l-ʿabdu, wa kullunā laka ʿabd. allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
